articles.summary: Alphatec Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: ATEC), a spine-focused provider of innovative solutions dedicated to revolutionizing the approach to spine surgery, today announced it has entered into a new credit facility, including a $125 million revolving credit facility and $175 million Term Loan A, led by JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. and TD Securities (USA) LLC. This transaction represents ATEC’s inaugural syndicated bank facility and reflects the Company’s strong operating performance and continued progression to a more scaled and profitable financial profile. The new facility refinances the Company’s existing debt, including its prior term loan and asset-based lending facilities with Braidwell LP, Pharmakon Advisors LP, and MidCap Financial Trust, simplifies its capital structure, reduces borrowing costs, and extends maturities to 2031.
